scope: Three synthetic RSS GETs to check query construction and unchanged local filtering; not a relevance/coverage acceptance test.
assertions: Every required term is appended to the provider query as a double-quoted literal with backslash and quote escaping.
The caller query is preserved verbatim, including any site: operator.
The existing parser still requires all terms to occur in cleaned title plus snippet; candidates missing any term are rejected.
No expected provider result count or relevance is asserted.
